data.name: Swift Combination
data.description: A rapid assault that strikes the enemy and stops them from buffing.
data.battleDescription: %user delivers a flurry of fast, precise strikes that overwhelm %target’s focus. The impact disrupts their chakra flow, locking them out from activating any self-enhancing techniques.

data.name: Swallow's Flight Slice
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: Closing the gap with the speed and relentless of a demon %user draws his bokken and strikes with the force of 100  men

data.name: Stonebreaker Strike
data.description: A brutal earth-based taijutsu blow that smashes through defenses and shatters the ground.
data.battleDescription: %user roots themselves to the ground, channeling dense earth chakra through their body and into their strike. With a sudden forward step, they deliver a crushing blow aimed at breaking not just the opponent, but the terrain itself. The sheer force of the attack sends a deep shockwave through the ground, cracking stone and rupturing the earth beneath their feet.

data.name: Crimson Orb
data.description: Dojiri enrage timer
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a sphere of blood from his previous encounters and hovers it above him in preparation of a blood bath recovery

data.name: Quicksand Mirages
data.description: induces panic on the target by making them believe they are suddenly being trapped in quicksand.
data.battleDescription: %user bends the mind of %target and creates an illusion of them sinking into quicksand. The feeling is real as their body sinks into the sand, they can feel their body getting stuck under the pressure falling into a state of panic.

data.name: Final Boss Phase 2
data.description: Ensnares all in unending lunar stillness.
data.battleDescription: %user calls forth the moon’s eternal stillness, casting a shadow of timeless peace across the battlefield. In this serene dominion, both %user and %target find themselves unable to alter their power or weaknesses. The world seems to hold its breath, as all movement of strength and vulnerability is frozen beneath the moon's unwavering glow.

data.name: Blazing Edge
data.description: A focused strike that channels intense fire chakra into shape of a blade, cutting through and igniting the enemy.
data.battleDescription: Flames taking the shape of a sword erupt from %user’s palm as they focus their chakra, the flames being a searing extension of their will. With a deadly swing, %user strikes %target, the blade carving through them as flames burst forth, setting their body alight. The fire clings to %target, burning even after the initial strike.

data.name: Molten Fury
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and inflicts lingering mental burns.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and initiates a searing genjutsu where molten lava pours from the sky, engulfing the target in a hellish illusion. Though the damage is purely mental, the torment lingers, causing %target to feel continuous internal burning that chips away at their psyche each turn. The illusion blurs reality, leaving them unsure if the pain will ever stop.

data.name: Stone Stomp
data.description: A powerful stomp that creates a shockwave.
data.battleDescription: %user channels earth chakra into their leg, stomping with immense force to create fissures that unbalance %target while dealing significant damage.

data.name: Eclipse Drain
data.description: A cursed enhancement that boosts the user’s damage and restores health with every strike.
data.battleDescription: %user draws in a slow breath as a shadow-like chakra coils around their arms and chest, pulsing with violent rhythm. Their strikes begin to land harder, the weight of each hit intensified by dark energy. As they attack, part of the damage inflicted siphons back into their body—restoring vitality through every blow.

data.name: Rock Fortress Strike
data.description: A sturdy, high-impact strike that deals damage and reduces incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into %target with brute force, causing the ground to erupt on impact. As the dust settles, rock formations rise around %user, reinforcing their stance and reducing the damage they take from follow-up attacks.

data.name: Thunder Chain Slash
data.description: A lightning-infused bukijutsu strike that deals damage and stuns the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into a chained weapon and unleashes a sudden, snapping slash toward %target. The moment the weapon strikes, a burst of electricity erupts from the point of contact, locking up the enemy’s muscles with a violent jolt. The electric backlash leaves %target momentarily paralyzed, caught in the crackling wake of the chained assault.

data.name: Dark World
data.description: A Forbidden Jutsu that releases the shadows of the underworld on target.
data.battleDescription: %user forces chakra through their body, causing it to pour into their body. The chakra mixes with their shadow, which grows and absorbs every bit of shadow in the vicinity. As the shadow spreads around %target it also expands, covering the surrounding area in complete darkness. The moment the jutsu hits completely locks %target in a dome of darkness, black razor spikes rapidly jut and retract out of the ground around stabbing %target

data.name: Hurricane Strike
data.description: A swift, spinning kick enhanced by wind chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their leg, executing a spinning kick that generates a powerful gust, striking %target with force and sending them reeling backward.

data.name: Blistering Rebound
data.description: Burn your attackers and use your elements to boost your offensive stats
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra and increases their prowess while surrounding themself in a fiery aura, burning all who would attack.

data.name: Moose Prime
data.description: Jutsu focusing on primordial chakra manipulation
data.battleDescription: %user harnesses the primordial chakra of his bloodline into his crown creating an aura that devours incoming attacks.

data.name: Black Coffin
data.description: Unite, repulse, fill the earth, and know your own powerlessness.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a sphere of intensified gravity centered around %target. The affected area appears shrouded in a swirling mass of pitch darkness with faint, glowing patterns resembling constellations, symbolizing the weight of the universe crushing down

data.name: Cyclone Palm Strike
data.description: A fierce palm strike that increases enemy damage taken and recoils part of incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes with the Cyclone Palm, amplifying the damage %target takes and recoiling a portion of their own attacks back at them.

data.name: Surging Kick
data.description: A roundhouse kick so deadly it stings like a past lover’s kiss.
data.battleDescription: %user stays light on their toes dancing in place. Finding the perfect timing %user sweeps their kick across %target’s face landing fiercely with strength.

data.name: Earth Release: The World
data.description: Earth Release: The World is an A-Rank Genjutsu that ensnares the target in a vivid and all-encompassing illusion. The target perceives the world around them crumbling away into a desolate, barren wasteland.
data.battleDescription: %user swiftly forms a series of intricate hand signs, their chakra surging into %target's mind. Suddenly, %target’s surroundings dissolve, replaced by an endless, desolate wasteland where the ground cracks and the horizon stretches infinitely. %target watches helplessly as familiar landscapes and structures crumble into dust. The air grows heavy and oppressive, filled with a sense of hopelessness and isolation. The illusion's realism is so profound that %target feels their spirit waver, the psychological weight of the endless desolation crushing their resolve. Meanwhile, %user remains composed, their true surroundings unchanged, as %target is consumed by the illusionary world's overwhelming despair.

data.name: Crimson Spires
data.description: A cursed spike technique that makes the enemy take more damage and suffer recoil when they strike.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures blood-red chakra spikes beneath %target’s feet. The moment they pierce upward, they embed a lingering curse that tears at the %target’s body whenever they move or attack. All incoming damage becomes harder to withstand, and each strike %target makes sends backlash through their own frame.

data.name: Kinjutsu: Black Thorn Rose
data.description: Once learned, this jutsu marks the user with a tiny rose bud that grows with each use, feeding off the user’s life force. Once the jutsu is activated, it plants a rose on the target that siphons their energy away.
data.battleDescription: Chakra vines grow out from %user and latch on to %target  suppressing their ability to heal and regenerate.

data.name: Summon: Totem of Okami
data.description: A Totem to show praises to Okami
data.battleDescription: %user places a scroll on the ground, clasping their hands together, they begin to sing praises to Okami as a great totem appears on the battlefield

data.name: Thunder’s Judgement
data.description: A punishing lightning technique that weakens the enemy and reflects damage back at them.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a surge of lightning chakra that strikes %target, weakening their stats. While active, any damage %target deals is partially reflected back through reactive lightning.

data.name: Shard Pulse Eruption
data.description: An explosive burst of chakra shards that injures the enemy and protects the users from harm.
data.battleDescription: %user detonates a condensed orb of chakra into a volatile spread of shards that rip into %target. The lingering fragments remain embedded, distorting chakra flow—forcing the target to suffer additional pain each time they strike back.

data.name: Tidal Crash
data.description: Uses water-enhanced strikes to overwhelm the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into the water, amplifying their strength to unleash a series of powerful, wave-infused blows that batter %target, leaving them soaked and disoriented.

data.name: Mizukumi
data.description: A water-based jutsu that strikes hard and absorbs some of the damage dealt to restore the user.
data.battleDescription: %user moves like liquid vengeance—fluid, controlled, and deadly. As they strike %target, water chakra clings to their limbs like a second skin, lashing out with every movement. Upon impact, Mizukumi siphons the force of the blow, pulling a portion of the enemy’s vitality into the user’s own body. The water ripples with life, wrapping around %user like a veil of stolen strength. Each strike doesn’t just punish—it replenishes.

data.name: Tidal Slice
data.description: A swift water-infused slash that deals damage and reduces damage taken by the user.
data.battleDescription: %user pivots swiftly and releases a sweeping arc of reinforced water chakra that tears into %target. As the surge crashes forward, a protective layer of water pressure envelops the user’s body, softening incoming attacks.

data.name: Ethereal Bloom
data.description: A graceful support technique that boosts healing effects and reduces incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user blossoms with chakra-infused energy that calms the body and hardens the spirit. As ethereal chakra petals drift around them, healing becomes more effective and damage is softened, shielding them in a veil of resilience.

data.name: Tides of Despair
data.description: A genjutsu that engulfs the enemy in a sorrowful tide, dealing damage and decreasing future damage taken.
data.battleDescription: Waves of illusion crash down upon %target, carrying with them the weight of despair and failure. The enemy becomes overwhelmed by visions of loss and futility, their attacks dulled by a mind too heavy to focus. The user's chakra synchronizes with the flow, reinforcing their mental defenses against incoming assaults.

data.name: Gale Force Blast
data.description: A piercing wind burst that rips through defenses and amplifies ninjutsu vulnerability.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses a violent burst of wind chakra into a narrow stream and launches it toward %target. The blast drills through defenses, disrupting their chakra flow and making them more vulnerable to all incoming ninjutsu techniques.

data.name: First Chakra Gate
data.description: unlocks the user's chakra flow, enhancing their Ninjutsu abilities.
data.battleDescription: A deep roar echoes from within as %user tears open the first chakra gate. Their aura erupts in a violent surge of energy, rippling through the air like a heatwave. Veins glow beneath their skin as raw chakra floods their network, amplifying every movement and sharpening their control. The ground beneath them fractures under the pressure, and the battlefield trembles as their ninjutsu flares with newfound ferocity faster, heavier, and more destructive than before.

data.name: Reptile 3: CBE
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user empowers %target with the power of the reptiles

data.name: Stone Shuriken Technique
data.description: The user creates shurikens made of compacted earth, which can be used for throwing or as melee weapons.
data.battleDescription: As %user creates shurikens from compacted earth, %target braces for the incoming assault. With a swift motion, %user hurls the stone shurikens at %target, each impact sending a shockwave of earth through %target's body. The barrage of shurikens leaves %target battered and bruised, struggling to withstand the relentless assault of earthy projectiles.

data.name: Stone Warden
data.description: A crushing earth genjutsu that suppresses the enemy’s mental prowess and offensive output.
data.battleDescription: A towering illusion of an ancient stone guardian erupts from the battlefield, crashing down upon %target with terrifying force. The overwhelming presence of the Stone Warden fractures their focus, suppressing their ninjutsu and genjutsu potential while dulling their intelligence and willpower. The enemy is left mentally burdened and less capable of mounting an effective counterattack.

data.name: Lightning Cloak
data.description: Enshrouded in crackling energy, the user dons a mantle of lightning—amplifying the ferocity of their electric attacks until every strike sings with thunder’s fury.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds their body in a radiant sheath of crackling lightning, each muscle fiber twitching with raw power. As they move, arcs of electricity trail behind them, boosting both speed and force. Their strikes become charged with piercing energy, enhancing the impact of all lightning-based techniques with devastating precision.

data.name: Wind Release: Whirlwind Demise
data.description: A raging windstorm that boosts power .
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a fierce whirlwind, amplifying their strikes while reducing the impact of incoming attacks.

data.name: Earth Release: Crushing Boulder
data.description: The user summons a massive boulder made of earth and hurls it at the target, crushing anything in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a towering boulder and hurls it at %target, smashing them with devastating force.

data.name: Sage Mode Test 2
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Rending Finish
data.description: Byakuho finisher
data.battleDescription: %user reaches %target and envelopes them, taking their last breath and using it to destroy all other enemies around

data.name: Earthquake Guard
data.description: A powerful defensive strike that boosts the user's Bukijutsu, Strength, and Speed.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground with controlled force, sending a shockwave through the earth that ripples toward %target. As stone and dust erupt into the air, the impact reinforces %user’s physical form, sharpening reflexes and bolstering their power. The terrain trembles beneath their stance, radiating raw force that surges into their body, heightening their Bukijutsu might, strength, and speed.

data.name: Ryūsa Kōka
data.description: An earth-style reinforcement that boosts offensive power and hardens the user’s body against incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user envelops their body in a dense, moving layer of fortified earth chakra. The hardened flow surges with pressure, sharpening attacks and absorbing impact, allowing the user to strike harder while enduring more punishment.

data.name: Crescent Strike
data.description: An advance blade technique that takes the shape of the cresent moon
data.battleDescription: %user dashes towards the opponent as they are about to make contact, they disappear and thrust the opponent into the air.  Attacking from above, their blade takes the shape of the crescent moon as they cleave the opponent

data.name: Siren's Lure
data.description: Conjures an alluring illusion of aquatic beauty.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves their hands through the air, summoning a haunting melody that echoes across the battlefield. A shimmering figure of unmatched beauty emerges from the water, entrancing %target with its ethereal song. As %target is drawn towards the apparition, they are ensnared in a web of deceit, their senses overwhelmed by the phantom's allure. The illusion manipulates their perception of reality, making it difficult for them to distinguish friend from foe, ultimately leaving them vulnerable to %user's next move.

data.name: Widow's Maw
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Corrupting Miasma
data.description: A deadly cloud of poisonous chakra spreads across the battlefield, weakening and sickening all who inhale it. The more chakra the enemy uses, the stronger the poison's effect becomes.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a swirling mist of dark green and purple poison, shrouding the battlefield. %target feels their body weaken as the venom seeps in. With each jutsu they cast, the poison intensifies, draining their strength. The more they fight, the faster their own chakra betrays them.

data.name: Lunar Descent
data.description: A haunting genjutsu that deals damage and applies damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user uses their genjutsu to manipulate %target's senses, making them believe the moon is plummeting toward them, overwhelming them with agonizing sensations and terror as they are convinced of an impending catastrophic impact.

data.name: Chains of Flame
data.description: Trap your target with chains made of flames.
data.battleDescription: %user hits the ground and releases their chakra into the cracks. The earth then ruptures below %targets as chains made of flaming kunai wrap themselves around %target, rendering them unable to move.

data.name: Earthen Echo
data.description: Uses the sound of shifting earth to create disorienting echoes.
data.battleDescription: %user manipulates the earth to produce a series of echoing sounds that reverberate around the opponent. The constant shifting and rumbling noises make it difficult for the opponent to pinpoint %user location or focus on their surroundings. Confused and overwhelmed by the auditory illusions, the opponent is left vulnerable to %user’s next move.

data.name: Pickpocket
data.description: Using your stealthy ninja techniques, you steal money from unsuspecting people
data.battleDescription: %user summons a dummy that is so obvious it actually works. While %target is distracted, %user takes their ryo

data.name: Windslicer Roundhouse
data.description: roundhouse kick empowered by wind chakra, creating a slicing gust.
data.battleDescription: %user’s leg arcs through the air, wind chakra trailing behind like a razor-edged crescent, striking %target with a forceful gust that cuts and pushes them backward.

data.name: Volt Jab Barrage
data.description: A lightning-fast barrage of jabs that weakens the enemy’s body while amplifying the user’s power.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists spark to life as lightning surges through their limbs. In a flash, they close the distance and unleash a relentless barrage of precise jabs, each punch crackling with high-voltage chakra. Every hit sends jolts through %target’s nervous system, overloading muscles, slowing reaction time, and breaking their physical rhythm. As %target’s strength, speed, and guard deteriorate, the electricity surging through %user only intensifies—sharpening their own taijutsu power.

data.name: Eclipsing Gales
data.description: A high-speed wind-based slash that deals damage and wounds the enemy
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a blur of motion, appearing behind %target with a slicing wind-charged strike. The impact destabilizes the enemy’s stance and leaves them wide open to follow-up Bukijutsu assaults.

data.name: Dancing Wind
data.description: A graceful wind-based strike that deals damage and makes the target more vulnerable to future attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user spins with flowing precision, unleashing a series of slicing wind arcs that strike %target from multiple angles. Each cut tears at their guard, leaving them more susceptible to incoming damage.

data.name: Hellfire Bark
data.description: A cruel ninjutsu  that damages the enemy and empowers the user’s stats.
data.battleDescription: %user opens their maw release an infernal bark igniting the air around %target

data.name: Voltblade Barrage
data.description: Charges the weapon with high-voltage electricity, enabling the user to deliver rapid, electrifying strikes.
data.battleDescription: %user weapon hums with lethal energy, vibrating with the power of high-voltage electricity. In a blur of motion, %user unleashes a flurry of strikes, each one delivering a jolt of electricity that courses through %target’s body. The rapid assault overwhelms %target’s defenses, the electrical energy searing their nerves with each hit.

data.name: Heartwood Strike
data.description: Kinmokuzai  filler attack
data.battleDescription: %user vines lash out in a violent display of aggravation at %target

data.name: Cyclone Shredder
data.description: A violent spiraling wind technique that tears through anything in its path.
data.battleDescription: %user forms rapid hand seals and releases a concentrated vortex of slicing wind toward %target. The spiraling gust roars forward like a bladed storm, shredding terrain and tearing into the opponent with overwhelming force.

data.name: Phoenix Flame Illusion
data.description: Creates an illusion of a phoenix attacking with flames.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a swift sequence of hand seals, unleashing an illusion of a colossal phoenix made of pure fire. The flaming bird ascends into the sky, then dives straight through %target in a blinding cascade of light. Though no physical flames touch them, the burning vision scorches their senses, delivering powerful mental damage.

data.name: Inferno Slash
data.description: A fiery slash that deals damage and makes the enemy more vulnerable to future attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user channels blazing fire chakra into their weapon and slashes at %target in a wide arc. The strike erupts on contact, searing through defenses and leaving behind scorching embers that increase the damage the target will take from future attacks.

data.name: Elemental Combo Test
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Fleeting Strike
data.description: A swift water-charged strike to the ground that sends out an area shockwave to damage nearby enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user charges water chakra into their heel before slamming it into the ground with sudden force. The impact sends a pressurized ripple of water surging outward in all directions, creating a shallow, fast-moving shockwave across the terrain. %target is struck not by a direct hit, but by the spreading blast zone that tears through footing and balance.

data.name: Sunlit Empowerment
data.description: Channels the radiant energy of the sun to envelop the user in a powerful aura, temporarily boosting their physical strength and endurance.
data.battleDescription: %user invokes Sunlit Empowerment, bathing in the radiant glow of the sun. As the empowering aura surrounds them, the user experiences a surge in strength and endurance, ready to face the challenges ahead with heightened prowess.

data.name: Voltari
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user summons lightning from the heavens, drawing it directly down upon %target body and containing the current within and around their form. Electricity crackles violently across %target body

data.name: Tempestual Fury
data.description: Tempest's Fury is a wind-element Ninjutsu that summons a devastating storm of immense size and power.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a raging tempest, its ferocious winds slamming into %target with relentless force.

data.name: Shattering Strike
data.description: A powerful  blow that deals damage and reduces incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user delivers a crushing strike aimed to fracture %target’s guard and morale. The force of the impact not only deals damage but also hardens the user’s stance, making them more resilient to incoming attacks.

data.name: Pill Pack: Chakra Pill III
data.description: A pill made from a 1000 year ginseng
data.battleDescription: %user quickly bites into the pill releasing all the stored chakra within it given them an extreme boost in strength.

data.name: Flame Burst Punch
data.description: A fiery punch that explodes on impact, dealing intense damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into their fist, igniting it with fierce flames. With a powerful punch, they strike %target, triggering an explosive burst of fire that scorches and disorients them, leaving them reeling.

data.name: Tempest Dash
data.description: A powerful wind-propelled dash.
data.battleDescription: In the heat of battle, %user focuses their chakra, allowing it to flow into their legs. With a sudden surge of energy, the air around them whirls and intensifies. In an instant, %user propels themselves forward with the force of a tempest, moving at a speed that seems almost impossible. The wind roars in their wake, creating a vortex that disturbs the surroundings and momentarily disorients any nearby foes. As %user completes their dash, they reappear in a new position, ready to strike or evade further assaults, while the chaotic winds they leave behind continue to buffet the opponent.

data.name: Flame Vortex
data.description: A violent spiral of fire that erupts beneath the enemy and engulfs them in searing destruction.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into the earth, erupting a spinning column of flames beneath %target. The spiraling inferno engulfs them in a brutal surge of heat and force, designed for pure devastation without any lingering effects.

data.name: Greater Vacuum Bullet
data.description: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, making it very difficult for one to avoid without injury
data.battleDescription: %user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, all converging on %target making it impossible to dodge

data.name: Geo Eruption
data.description: This jutsu utilizes the earth element in order to explode a rock formation to deny the opponent cover while heavily punishing them for it.
data.battleDescription: %user causes the ground beneath %target to erupt with molten earth and jagged rocks, continuously inflicting damage.

data.name: Phantom Whirlpool
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and boosts the user's genjutsu damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures the illusion of a massive whirlpool swirling beneath %target’s feet, dragging their senses into a spiraling abyss. As the illusion tightens, the crushing pressure distorts their perception, causing real damage and mentally fracturing their defenses. The user’s mastery over the genjutsu deepens with the cast, heightening the force behind future illusions.

data.name: Earth Release: Spike Barrage
data.description: The user creates multiple sharp spikes of earth that shoot up from the ground, targeting multiple enemies.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels their Earth Release chakra, the ground beneath %target trembles and fractures. Suddenly, sharp spikes of earth erupt in a barrage around %target, striking with pinpoint accuracy. The relentless assault leaves %target and other enemies battered and wounded, the battlefield now a dangerous terrain of jagged earth.

data.name: Crashing Wave Palm
data.description: A swift, water‑infused palm strike that delivers solid damage and envelops the user in a watery barrier, reducing incoming damage
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra into their palm, forming rippling currents around their arm. With a deep breath, they dash forward, their movements fluid like the ocean. Upon contact, the palm strike releases a compressed burst of water pressure, slamming into %target with crushing force. The strike not only deals direct damage but wraps %user in a protective layer of moving water, softening the blows of subsequent attacks. The battlefield ripples with the aftermath of the blow, as if a wave had passed through.

data.name: Wind Dance
data.description: A graceful Taijutsu technique that uses wind to enhance the user’s agility and evasion, allowing them to move swiftly and avoid incoming attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user harmonizes with the wind, their body surrounded by swift, circulating currents. The flowing air cushions incoming blows to decrease damage taken, while sharpening their strikes and movements to greatly enhance offensive power.

data.name: Wind Release: Tempest Edge
data.description: The user channels wind chakra into their weapon, creating a blade enveloped in a swirling vortex of wind that increases cutting power.
data.battleDescription: With a powerful swing, %user imbues their weapon with swirling wind chakra, forming a tempestuous blade. As they bring it down upon %target, the blade cuts through the air with a ferocious howl, striking with the force of a raging storm. The tempestuous energy enhances the blade's cutting power, aiming to inflict devastating damage upon impact.

data.name: KGK: KX Hollow Surge
data.description: An unstable enhancement technique born from early KX experimentation, KX Hollow Surge forces violent chakra throughout the user’s body to overwhelm nearby targets through relentless offensive pressure. Those struck by the surge find their defenses destabilized as the corrupted energy leaves them increasingly vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
data.battleDescription: Violent chakra erupts around %user as KX Hollow Surge tears across the battlefield, the unstable energy overwhelming %target and leaving their defenses exposed beneath the crushing pressure.

data.name: Summon: Totem of Fujin
data.description: A Totem to show praises to Fujin
data.battleDescription: %user places a scroll on the ground, clasping their hands together, they begin to sing praises to Fujin as a great totem appears on the battlefield

data.name: Aether Bow
data.description: The user creates a bow made of condensed wind chakra, imbuing it with the properties of the wind itself. The bowstring is formed from swirling winds, and the arrows are made of compressed air.
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Aether Bow, drawing back the ethereal bowstring. As they release, the arrow made of compressed air shoots forth with incredible speed and force, cutting through the air with a faint, whistling sound. The arrow strikes %target with the power of a gusting wind, dealing damage with the force of a natural disaster.

data.name: Water Release: Water Dragon Blade
data.description: Forge a dragon of water around your blade to savage enemies and boost your healing power.
data.battleDescription: %user shapes water into a coiled dragon around their blade. They lunge — the dragon strikes first, jaws snapping around %target, empowering %user’s ability to heal.

data.name: Sticky Fingers
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Iron Fist Fury
data.description: A punishing taijutsu strike that boosts the user’s hand-to-hand power after impact.
data.battleDescription: %user surges forward, fists clenched with dense chakra and full-bodied intent. They unleash a ruthless strike against %target, each punch landing with the weight of forged iron. The assault stuns not just with power, but precision. As the final hit lands, the chakra coursing through %user intensifies—sharpening their Taijutsu ability, tightening reaction speed, and reinforcing every movement.

data.name: Liver Shot
data.description: Taijutsu that deals damage and increases damage taken by the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user ducks low and delivers a sudden, precise hook directly to the opponent’s side—targeting the liver with surgical brutality. The blow causes the enemy’s body to seize and stagger, not only dealing painful internal damage but also leaving them more vulnerable to follow-up strikes. This genin-level taijutsu technique is feared for its crippling effect and ability to open the enemy up to increased damage.

data.name: Tsunami's Embrace
data.description: A masterful water-element genjutsu that conjures a colossal tsunami crashing down upon the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra with precision, conjuring an illusionary tsunami that surges towards %target with incredible force. The roaring waters rise to towering heights, blotting out the sky as they crash down upon %target with deafening fury. %target feels the crushing weight of the waves bearing down upon them, unable to escape the relentless onslaught of the illusionary tsunami.

data.name: Great Vacuum Bullet
data.description: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, making it very difficult for one to avoid without injury
data.battleDescription: %user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatters in different directions, all converging on %target making it impossible to dodge

data.name: Sealing Contagion
data.description: Akaibako attack 2
data.battleDescription: %user takes a kunai and makes a small cut on her hand, green blood slowly drops down her arm before she darts forward and slices into %target using the same kunai.

data.name: Warden's Zephyr
data.description: A slicing wind jutsu that strikes the enemy and surrounds the user in a protective barrier of air.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a sharp gust of compressed wind that slams into %target with cutting force. As the wave disperses, the wind coils back toward the caster, forming a swirling shield of chakra-infused air.

data.name: Infernal Surge
data.description: Channeling searing flames, the user ignites their body and strikes, engulfing their foe in fire while fueling their own attacks with unrelenting heat.
data.battleDescription: A roar of flame erupts as %user’s body ignites with blazing energy, surging forward in a torrent of fire. The onslaught engulfs %target, searing through defenses while each ember clings to %user—feeding their power, amplifying the fury behind every strike that follows.

data.name: Rock Barrage
data.description: Launches multiple rock projectiles at the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground, channeling chakra to tear the earth apart beneath them. With a precise swing, they command jagged chunks of stone to rise and fly forward like deadly missiles. The barrage of sharpened rocks strikes the battlefield in a brutal, calculated rhythm, dealing heavy earth-based damage.

data.name: Blazing Death Star
data.description: Add fire nature chakra to your Shurikens
data.battleDescription: %user throws a barrage of shuriken at %target as they are  flying towards target they weave together handsigns as fire nature chakra envelops the shuriken increasing their speed and their destructive power

data.name: Final Boss Phase 3
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Body Flicker
data.description: A ninjutsu that deals damage and repositions the user on the battlefield.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a blur of motion, leaving behind a gust of wind and a flicker of light. In an instant, they reappear beside their opponent, striking with sharp precision before phasing away again. This technique not only inflicts damage but also allows the user to move freely across the battlefield, disrupting enemy positioning and preparing for the next assault.

data.name: Weight of the Earth
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user begins converting the ground itself into a miasma of heavy mud

data.name: Fire Walking Ninjutsu
data.description: This jutsu allows the user to walk on fire without getting burned, leaving a trail of flames behind.
data.battleDescription: %user performs Fire Walking Ninjutsu, walking on fire and creating a trail of flames that damages the target.

data.name: Gale Mirage
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and reflects part of the damage back onto the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a single-handed seal, and the air begins to shimmer with illusory distortions. A cascade of spectral wind blades surrounds %target, slicing into their senses and nerves with phantom pain. As they react, a portion of their own force is turned against them—reflected through the genjutsu’s twisting illusions—causing recoil damage that echoes the pain they inflict.

data.name: Terra Crush
data.description: A powerful strike that channels the weight of the earth into the weapon, delivering a crushing blow.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground, pulling up a massive chunk of earth with the force of their chakra. With a single fluid motion, they hurl the earth at %target, smashing into them with the full weight of the land. The impact sends %target crashing to the ground, crushed beneath the debris.

data.name: Mountain Crusher
data.description: A devastating earth-powered strike that reduces the enemy’s ability to deal damage
data.battleDescription: Description: %user drives forward with immovable force, earth chakra wrapping around their limb like the weight of a mountain. The strike lands against %target with crushing density, sending a seismic jolt through their frame.

data.name: Earth Release: Ground Chasm
data.description: You manipulate the terrain to bolster your defenses
data.battleDescription: %user weaves hand seals, and the battlefield cracks apart with a thunderous quake. A wide chasm rips open between %user and their attackers, forcing a sudden divide. The gaping pit serves as an unyielding barrier, cutting off enemy advances while bolstering %user’s defense through distance and terrain control.

data.name: Crippling Blade
data.description: Crippling Strike is a Forbidden S-Rank Bukijutsu that enhances the user's weapon with a dark, ominous aura, sapping the strength and agility of their foes, decreasing their Taijutsu prowess.
data.battleDescription: With a swift, calculated strike, %user's weapon is engulfed in a menacing, dark aura, crackling with malevolent energy. As the blade connects, the aura surges into %target's body, creeping through their veins like icy tendrils, sapping their strength and agility. %target's movements slow, each step becoming a laborious effort as the oppressive force of Crippling Strike weighs them down. The once nimble and powerful fighter now struggles against the debilitating effects of the jutsu, their Taijutsu prowess drained and diminished.
